articles.title: AI coding is a nightmare. Am I the only one experiencing this?
articles.summary: Here are my biggest gripes with AI coding assistants right now: Obsessed with reinventing the wheel. You'll often find it writing three duplicate functions for the exact same feature in a single file. Why? Because it's terrified of blowing up the context window, so it only reads a fraction of a large file and completely misses the existing functionality. Why are files so bloated in the first place?
